page.overview:
What is Rosemary and Thyme?

Rosemary and Thyme is a brothel located in the Glory Lane district of Novigrad.

It was originally owned and run by Alonso Wiley, better known as Whoreson Senior. Having been a patron of the arts and a fan of Dandelion's, Whoreson Senior left the business to the bard when he died. Dandelion then invited his friend Zoltan Chivay to run it together as a tavern.

After Dandelion is saved from the Temple Guard by the witcher, he renames the establishment to the Chameleon and refurbishes it into a cabaret and tavern. The end result is determined by the player through earlier dialogue choices.
